# 1963 Chevrolet Corvair Shop Manual

This is the working composite for **1963 Corvair passenger cars**. The factory
1961 Corvair and Corvair 95 shop manual supplies base procedures; the 1962–63
supplement supplies later changes. The 1963 model identification table lists the
500 coupe, 700 coupe and sedan, and 900 (Monza) coupe, convertible, and sedan;
Monza Spyder is identified as an option. The 1200-series Corvair 95 vehicles are
outside this manual's passenger-car scope. The factory supplement explicitly
states that the 700 and Monza station wagons were canceled for 1963.

**Conversion status: in progress.** The original PDF sections are acquired and
mapped, but the cleaned 1963-only procedures and specification tables are not
complete. Do not use an unreviewed OCR draft as a service specification.

The [source inventory](data/source-inventory.json) records each original PDF,
its download URL, size, SHA-256, and physical page count. The
[source page map](data/source-page-map.jsonl) maps each combined working page
back to its original file, physical page, and printed page when readable in the
running page header (653 of 742 pages). Other printed-page labels remain
unverified.
The continuity audit maps all 742 physical pages, but 39 adjacent printed-page
labels disagree with their PDF positions; these are OCR or scan-order questions
that still require image review. See the
[continuity report](data/page-continuity-report.txt).
The original scans and working combined PDF are staged under ignored `_inbox/`.

No numeric value is promoted to the 1963 lookup merely because it appeared in
the base manual or a 1962 column. A 1963 fact needs explicit year, passenger
scope, source file, and printed page information. Ambiguous values and missing
coverage belong in `wiki/10-needs-review.md` until checked against the scan.
